---
title: "Documented case studies of eradication and control of invasive alien lizards"
date: "2026-05-04"
doi: "https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20021526"
output: html_document
---

The map shows the geographic distribution of documented cases in which invasive alien lizards were either eradicated or brought under control. When exact coordinates were not available in the original source, approximate locations were represented using the centroid of the relevant locality or country.

```{r create map, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

# 0. Load packages
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(htmlwidgets)

#----------------
# 1. Load Data
#----------------
data <- read.csv("./data/input/case_studies_with_coordinates.csv")


#-------------------
#2. Apply cleaning
#-------------------
data_clean <- data %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lat = as.numeric(gsub("\\.", "", as.character(coord_Y))),
    lon = as.numeric(gsub("\\.", "", as.character(coord_X))))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat= ifelse(abs(lat) > 100000, lat / 10000, lat / 1000),
                lon= ifelse(abs(lon) > 100000, lon / 10000, lon / 1000))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat = ifelse(lat==	-40.9006,-40.6100 , lat),
                lon = ifelse(lon==17.4886, 175.2547,lon))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat = ifelse(location==	"UK, Buckinghamshire",52.03127 , lat),
                lon = ifelse(location==	"UK, Buckinghamshire", -1.01765,lon))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat = ifelse(location==	"USA, Hawaii" & Species=="Emoia cyanura",22.0964 , lat),
                lon = ifelse(location==	"USA, Hawaii" & Species==	"Emoia cyanura", -159.5261,lon))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat = ifelse(location==	"Seychelles, St. Anne" & Species=="Calotes versicolor",-4.613 , lat),
                lon = ifelse(location==	"Seychelles, St. Anne" & Species=="Calotes versicolor", 55.503,lon))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat = ifelse(location==	"USA, Hawaii"& Species=="Chamaeleo calyptratus",20.709722 , lat),
                lon = ifelse(location==	"USA, Hawaii" & Species=="Chamaeleo calyptratus", -156.253333,lon))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat = ifelse(location==	"Spain, La Rioja"& Species=="Podarcis siculus",42.287073 , lat),
                lon = ifelse(location==	"Spain, La Rioja" & Species=="Podarcis siculus", -2.539603,lon))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat = ifelse(location==	"UK, Dorset"& Species=="Podarcis muralis",50.7209 , lat),
                lon = ifelse(location==	"UK, Dorset" & Species=="Podarcis muralis", -1.8348,lon))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat = ifelse(location==	"Spain. Urgull"& Species=="Podarcis pityusensis",43.32472 , lat),
                lon = ifelse(location==	"Spain. Urgull" & Species=="Podarcis pityusensis", -1.98889,lon),
                location = ifelse(location==	"Spain. Urgull" & Species=="Podarcis pityusensis", "Spain, San Sebastian (Monte Urgull)",location))%>%
  dplyr::mutate(lat = ifelse(location==	"Spain, Bilbao and Getaria"& Species=="Podarcis siculus",43.26252 , lat),
                lon = ifelse(location==	"Spain, Bilbao and Getaria" & Species=="Podarcis siculus", -2.91869,lon),
                location = ifelse(location==	"Spain, Bilbao and Getaria" & Species=="Podarcis siculus", "Spain, Bilbao (Parque Etxebarria)",location))%>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(lat) & !is.na(lon))


# Create duplicate of the Bilbao row
bilbao_new <- data_clean %>%
  dplyr::filter(location == "Spain, Bilbao (Parque Etxebarria)" & 
                Species == "Podarcis siculus") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(location = "Spain, Getaria (Ratón de Getaria)",
                lat = 43.3086,
                lon = -2.2019)

# Add the new row to the dataset
data_clean <- dplyr::bind_rows(data_clean, bilbao_new)%>%
  dplyr::select(-c(coord_X, coord_Y))%>%
  dplyr::rename(species = Species)%>%
  dplyr::relocate(lat, .after = location)%>%
  dplyr::relocate(lon, .after = lat)

# Lump Categories
# I, M, C -> Control (Black)
# E, DE -> Eradication (Red)
data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Category = case_when(
    trimws(measure) %in% c("C", "I", "M") ~ "Control",
    trimws(measure) %in% c("E", "DE") ~ "Eradication",
    TRUE ~ "Other"),
  Color = ifelse(Category == "Control", "black", "red"))

#---------------
#3. Create map
#---------------
leaflet(data_clean) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  setView(lng = 174, lat = -40, zoom = 4) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon, 
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = 8,
    fillColor = ~Color,
    color = "white",
    weight = 1.5,
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>", species, "</b><br>",
      "<hr>",
      "<b>Category:</b> ", Category, "<br>",
      "<b>Measure:</b> ", measure_full, "<br>",
      "<b>Location:</b> ", location, "<br>",
      "<b>Reference:</b> ", reference,"<br>",
      "<b>Reference DOI:</b> ", reference_DOI, "<br>",
      "<b>Reference link:</b> ", reference_link, "<br>",
      "<b>Notes:</b> ", notes
    ),
    clusterOptions = markerClusterOptions(
      spiderfyOnMaxZoom = TRUE,
      showCoverageOnHover = FALSE,
      zoomToBoundsOnClick = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    position = "topright",
    colors = c("black", "red"),
    labels = c("Control (C, I, M)", "Eradication (E, DE)"),
    title = "Management Category",
    opacity = 1
  )%>% htmlwidgets::onRender("
  function(el, x) {
    el.style.width = '100%';
    var map = this;
    map.setView([20, -15], 2);
  }
")

#Export
data_clean<-dplyr::select(data_clean, c(species, year, location, lat, lon, measure_full, reference, reference_DOI, reference_link, notes))%>%
  dplyr::rename(measure = measure_full)
write.csv(data_clean, "./data/output/alien_lizard_locations.csv", row.names=FALSE)

```
